summary: ClinicalPracticeCodes manages codes representing types of clinical practice activities within a program. It provides CRUD operations, search, validation, and reactivation functionality for clinical practice codes, ensuring each code is uniquely identified and properly validated before database actions.
purpose: To facilitate management (create, read, update, delete, search, and reactivate) of clinical practice codes tied to programs or students. This ensures codes are available, searchable, and their integrity is maintained within the system.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the clinical practice code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the clinical practice code.

fields.name: Inactive
fields.description: Indicates whether the code is inactive.

workflows.name: Add ClinicalPracticeCode
steps: Validate Name and ShortName are not blank.
If valid, set database procedure to 'ClinicalPracticeCodeAdd'.

workflows.name: Search ClinicalPracticeCode by Program
steps: Retrieve and return list of codes.

workflows.name: Search ClinicalPracticeCode by Student
steps: Retrieve and return list of codes.

business_rules: ID must be non-zero for update, delete, and reactivate operations.
conditions: ShowInactive: Determines if inactive codes should be included in search results.
ID != 0: Required for update, delete, reactivate.
system_behavior: Adds error messages to session when validation fails.
Uses stored procedures for all database operations.
Returns lists of codes as search results.
dependencies: HSPnetSession must be active for operations.

Database procedures exist: ClinicalPracticeCodeAdd, ClinicalPracticeCodeUpdate, ClinicalPracticeCodeDelete, ClinicalPracticeCodeReactivate, ClinicalPracticeCodeSearchProgram, ClinicalPracticeCodeSearchStudent.
exceptions: Validation errors on missing Name or ShortName.
content_gaps: No details on how Name and ShortName should be formatted beyond being non-blank.
No information about permissions or authorization.
No error handling for database failures.
